description: This file defines the StepSynchronizationManager class which manages thread-local context for batch step executions in a Spring Batch application. It provides methods for retrieving, registering, closing, and releasing step execution contexts, utilizing CGLIB proxies for tenant-aware behavior.

classes.name: StepSynchronizationManager
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to manage step execution contexts within Spring Batch, with thread-local support and tenant-awareness via CGLIB proxies.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread-local StepContext, if any.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Creates a proxy-enhanced StepExecution with tenant-awareness and registers it to obtain a corresponding StepContext.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the current step context.
